sql:
SELECT tbl5."channel" AS "channel", sum(tbl5."unit_price") AS "Summed price"
FROM "t_5" AS tbl5
GROUP BY tbl5."channel"
ORDER BY "Summed price" DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 500
warnings: "unit_price" is a rate or price, so adding it up does not produce a meaningful figure. An average is usually what is wanted.
